lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: The Ash Camp crews came in at dawn with your steel. Forty of them, down an open road, in daylight, which I would have called suicide on Tuesday. We hold. Whatever happens to us after, we hold this winter.

lines.speaker: ade
lines.text: We fall in a week and you know we fall in a week. Go home, Auditor. Go up those stairs and look at what you kept.
